title: Proposals to shoot at craft Bledsoe calls down

tellings.quote: and and you wouldn't believe um even proposals if I could get it to come down, could they shoot at it? I'm like, absolutely not.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he can draw UFOs down to where he is, tells Michels he was asked whether, if he could get one of the craft to come down, people could shoot at it. "You wouldn't believe," he says, that there were "even proposals" like that, and his answer was "absolutely not." He tells it as something he was part of himself, and it would mean that someone took his ability seriously enough to plan around it.
